ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 95:5 ratio of low-intensity black to high-intensity white/off-white pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant solid black pigmentation across both lobes. Focal high-contrast white linear clusters localized to the lower-left quadrant. Small, high-intensity white/beige clusters localized at the distal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a clearly defined central vertex and symmetrical divergence of the interior lobe edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern with pixel-amplitude variations ranging from 5-15 pixels. Jagged peaks are prominent along the entire horizontal span of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to tapered, slightly upturned distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed circular high-contrast pixel clusters (barnacle colonies) located at the extreme lateral margins of both the left and right fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of parallel and intersecting white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) concentrated on the lower-left ventral surface, extending from the fluke base toward the mid-lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at distal tips; multiple white linear scars/abrasions on the left lobe; irregular jagged trauma marks along the trailing edge topography.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced accumulation of sessile organisms at the distal tips forming distinct three-dimensional silhouettes against the background.
